class ArrayLiteral{x;constructor(){[this.x]=[1]}}
class ObjectLiteral{x;constructor(){({x:this.x}={x:1})}}
class Branch{x;constructor(flag:boolean){if(flag)[this.x]=[1];else [this.x]=['x'];}}
class Conditional{x;constructor(flag:boolean){[this.x]=flag?[1]:[2]}}
function identity<T>(value:T){return value;}
class GenericCall{x;constructor(){[this.x]=identity([1])}}
class Nullish{x;constructor(input:[number]|undefined){[this.x]=input??[1]}}
class ConstAsserted{x;constructor(){[this.x]=[1] as const}}
class AssertedElements{x;constructor(){[this.x]=[1 as number]}}
class Nested{x;constructor(){({nested:{x:this.x}}={nested:{x:1}})}}
class AngleConst{x;constructor(){[this.x]=<const>[1]}}
